questions.prompt: Which statement correctly describes Self-Hosted Runners?
options: Print all environment variables and event payloads to make the run easier to debug.
Run untrusted pull-request code in the same job that holds production credentials.
Self-hosted runners use registered machines and labels, so restrict which repositories and workflows can access them and avoid sharing privileged runners with untrusted jobs.
Give every job write permission to avoid troubleshooting authorization errors.
questions.answer_key: Self-hosted runners use registered machines and labels, so restrict which repositories and workflows can access them and avoid sharing privileged runners with untrusted jobs.
questions.explanation: This is the central behavior of self-hosted runners: Self-hosted runners use registered machines and labels, so restrict which repositories and workflows can access them and avoid sharing privileged runners with untrusted jobs. Assume the workflow is correct as soon as the YAML file is committed.
